annotations.text: Round 1 — three vintage-watch personalities for the RefCheck hero. Flip to Round 2 for three more.
A — Engineering Blueprint: cyanotype-blue technical drawing of a watch movement, leader lines, a real engineering title block. Leans hardest into the mechanical-engineering angle.
B — Watchmaker's Bench: warm dark walnut felt tray with loupe, tweezers, an open pocket watch. Tactile and crafted rather than diagrammatic.
C — The Case File: parchment dossier with a tilted photo exhibit, a paperclip, and a red 'DOCUMENTED' stamp. Narrative and forensic.
Round 2 — three more directions, further from the first set: a period-accurate 1930s deco catalogue, a repair-manual exploded view, and a stark instrument gauge.
D — 1930s Deco Catalogue: black and gold, sunburst rays, a stepped ziggurat frame around a deco watch face. Period-accurate to the actual watches, not generic luxury.
E — Service Manual Exploded View: aged manila paper, an isometric exploded stack of watch parts with a numbered parts list, like a real repair manual page.
F — Instrument Gauge: stark black/white/red, oversized industrial type, a chronometer-style confidence gauge with a needle — ties directly to the app's real confidence score.

G — Pale & Pop, refined: asymmetric composition, a torn/taped photo bleeding off the frame with halftone texture, a hand-drawn circle around the CTA, a handwritten note, a faint giant watermark of a real vintage Omega reference number, vertical running text. Fewer template tells, more designer fingerprints.
